t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Upernarsauunga, Gutiga â, Ivdlit pingortiikangama ilisariinissagavkit patlidorfiginissagavkitdlo. Mânakorporlak naasuerpunga piginautikinngnut ivdlitdlo pissanekarnermut, pitsûningnut ivdlitdlo pissâjunernut. Avdlamik Gutikângilak Ivdlit kisivit, navianartune ikiortét, tamanut sapigâkangitsoq.
